# Configuration reference

Every key lives in `$HERMES_HOME/config.yaml` under `plugins.pgvector`:

```yaml
plugins:
  pgvector:
    dsn: "dbname=hermes_memory user=hermes host=/var/run/postgresql"
    embed_url: "http://localhost:11434"
    embed_model: "nomic-embed-text"
    # ... any other key below, only where the default isn't right for you
```

Every key is optional; the table shows what the plugin uses when a key is
absent. In practice almost every real deployment sets `dsn` and `embed_url`
explicitly — the rest are tuning knobs. See [README.md](../README.md) for a
worked quick-start and [scaling.md](scaling.md) for guidance on
`embed_timeout` / `prefetch_budget` / pool sizing under load.

These keys are part of the plugin's public, semver-covered contract (see
"Compatibility policy" in [README.md](../README.md)): a key is not removed,
or given an incompatible new meaning, without a major-version bump.

| Key | Type | Default | Since | Effect |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `dsn` | `text` | `'dbname=hermes_memory user=hermes host=/var/run/postgresql connect_timeout=5'` — **required** | 0.1.0 | Postgres DSN (psycopg connection string) |
| `embed_url` | `text` | `'http://localhost:11434'` — **required** | 0.1.0 | Embedding endpoint base URL (OpenAI-compatible or Ollama native) |
| `embed_model` | `text` | `'nomic-embed-text'` | 0.1.0 | Embedding model name (must return embed_dim-length vectors; 768 by default) |
| `embed_dim` | `integer` (>= 1) | `768` | 0.5.3 | Vector length the embed model returns. Must also match the database's vector(N) columns (768 as created by migration 001). Changing it on an existing database requires migrating those columns and re-embedding every row -- see README, 'Changing the embedding dimension'. |
| `embed_api_key_env` | `text` | `''` | 0.5.3 | NAME of an environment variable holding a bearer token for the embed endpoint (e.g. OPENROUTER_API_KEY) -- never the token itself. Read at call time; when the variable is set and non-empty the plugin sends 'Authorization: Bearer <value>'. Empty = no Authorization header. |
| `embed_protocol` | `text`, one of `auto`, `openai`, `ollama` | `'auto'` | 0.5.3 | 'auto' tries the OpenAI-compatible /v1/embeddings path, then falls back to Ollama-native /api/embed. 'openai' uses /v1/embeddings only, so auth and unknown-model errors surface as-is (use it for OpenRouter / OpenAI). 'ollama' uses /api/embed only. Unknown values fall back to 'auto' with a warning. |
| `prefetch_limit` | `integer` (1–50) | `5` | 0.1.0 | Max ambient recall results injected per turn |
| `min_similarity` | `number` (0.0–1.0) | `0.3` | 0.1.0 | Cosine similarity cutoff for ambient prefetch |
| `embed_on_write` | `boolean` | `True` | 0.1.0 | Compute embedding on each write; turn off for text-only mode |
| `scope_default` | `text`, one of `current`, `all` | `'current'` | 0.1.0 | Default scope for recall_memory when caller omits it |
| `hybrid_search` | `boolean` | `True` | 0.4.1 | Fuse the HNSW vector ranking with a Postgres full-text ranking (Reciprocal Rank Fusion) in recall_memory / recall_conversation. Recovers exact-lexical hits cosine smooths away and text-only rows with NULL embeddings; degrades to pure vector on error and to full-text-only when the query fails to embed. Apply migration 003 for the GIN index (works without it, just slower). |
| `write_queue_maxsize` | `integer` (>= 1) | `256` | 0.1.0 | Bounded async-writer queue size; full = newest writes drop with a warning |
| `bulk_sync_on_init` | `boolean` | `True` | 0.1.1 | Import MEMORY.md / USER.md content from disk on agent init |
| `sync_turns` | `boolean` | `True` | 0.2.0 | Capture every substantive (user, assistant) turn pair into the conversations table |
| `turn_min_chars` | `integer` (>= 0) | `40` | 0.2.0 | Turns shorter than this (after strip) are treated as boilerplate and skipped |
| `allowed_themes` | `text` | `''` | 0.4.0 | Identity governance: optional allow-list of theme names, as a comma-separated string (e.g. 'marketing,sales'). Empty/unset = allow any. When set, an unknown X-Hermes-Session-Key falls back to 'default' with a one-time warning (the whatsapp-dm / external-group / _bench / default sinks are always permitted). |
| `identity_aliases` | `text` | `''` | 0.4.0 | Raw-identity remaps applied before normalization, as a comma-separated 'raw=canonical' string (e.g. 'mkt=marketing,sales-bot=sales'). A hand-edited config.yaml may instead use a YAML mapping -- both forms are accepted. |
| `bench_mode` | `text`, one of `bucket`, `reject` | `'bucket'` | 0.4.0 | How to handle benchmark identities (skill-bench, *-bench): 'bucket' isolates them to the '_bench' theme; 'reject' drops them to 'default'. |
| `conversation_embed_policy` | `text`, one of `all`, `substantive_only`, `none` | `'all'` | 0.4.0 | Which captured turns get an embedding. 'all' (recall-safe; every turn that passed the noise filter) \| 'substantive_only' (user turns + assistant turns >=120 chars; caps HNSW growth) \| 'none' (text-only, conversation recall disabled). |
| `ttl_days` | `integer` (>= 0) | `0` | 0.4.0 | Advisory retention window for conversations (memory_entries are NEVER pruned). 0 = off. Pruning only ever happens when an operator runs `hermes-pgvector prune` — this value is the default for that command, never an automatic background delete. |
| `embed_timeout` | `number` (>= 0.1) | `5.0` | 0.5.0 | Seconds to wait for an embedding on the AGENT thread (prefetch, recall_memory, recall_conversation) and during the init-time bulk import. Kept short on purpose: a timeout here degrades recall to full-text-only, which beats making the agent wait. Raise it only if recall quality matters more than latency on your endpoint. |
| `embed_write_timeout` | `number` (>= 0.1) | `30.0` | 0.5.0 | Seconds to wait for an embedding on the BACKGROUND writer path. Nothing waits on this, and giving up costs a permanently unsearchable row (recoverable only by `hermes-pgvector backfill`), so it is far more generous than embed_timeout. Raise it if your endpoint is slow: writes that time out land with a NULL embedding. |
| `embed_write_retries` | `integer` (>= 0) | `2` | 0.4.0 | Bounded embed retries on the background writer path ONLY (the hot path — prefetch/recall/sync — always uses a single attempt). Durable recovery of missed embeddings is the `hermes-pgvector backfill` sweep, not inline retries. |
| `embed_write_backoff` | `number` (>= 0.0) | `0.1` | 0.4.0 | Base seconds for the exponential backoff between embed_write_retries attempts on the background writer path (backoff * 2**attempt_index). |
| `write_contexts` | `text` | `'primary,cron'` | 0.6.0 | Comma-separated agent_context values (from initialize()'s kwargs) allowed to WRITE, e.g. 'primary,cron'. Contexts not listed skip on_memory_write / sync_turn / on_session_end / on_delegation (recall still works). A missing agent_context kwarg is treated as 'primary'. |
| `shutdown_drain_timeout` | `number` (>= 0.0) | `10.0` | 0.6.0 | Seconds shutdown() waits for the writer queue to drain. While draining, embeds are skipped (rows land text-only; `hermes-pgvector backfill` heals them later) so the drain stays DB-only and fast. |
| `prefetch_budget` | `number` (0.1–7.5) | `5.0` | 0.6.0 | Hard wall-clock budget (seconds) for prefetch()'s synchronous fallback path (embed + search), used when queue_prefetch() has not already cached a block for the session. Must stay below the host's external-provider prefetch timeout (8s), or the host logs a timeout warning and skips this provider on later turns until the stuck call returns. |
